description: Fréquentation en gares métropole d'Aix-Marseille-Provence is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Gares & Connexions. Ce jeu de données représente la fréquentation annuelle de l’ensemble des gares voyageurs de 2015 à 2018 sur le territoire de la métropole. Ces informations sont issues des données de billetterie pour le trafic national et régional. Coverage: Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis. The portal files it under Transports. Its keywords are Fréquentation, Gare de voyageurs, Gares. The portal shows 42 records. The portal shows 2020-07-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
